title: Execute as keeps a separate score for each self
description: Two marker executors each receive and increment their own score while a tagged third marker stays unchanged.

steps.command: execute as @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=!other] run scoreboard players add @s pp_exec 2

execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=first,scores={pp_exec=5}] if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=second,scores={pp_exec=5}] if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=other,scores={pp_exec=3}]

notes: Vanilla 26.3 reference expectations are checked live; raw responses remain in campaign artifacts. Simulation is frozen and restored in cleanup.
